mode: review-record validation; no external LLM execution

criteria.implementation-explanation: Reviewer correctly explains algorithm and changed code with source line citations.
criteria.test-adequacy: Reviewer identifies acceptance and regression tests with exact test path/line evidence.
criteria.security-and-scope: Reviewer flags over-broad changes or unsafe assumptions without unsupported claims.
criteria.root-cause-analysis: Reviewer ties a failure to observable source and reproducible test outcomes.
criteria.abstention: Reviewer abstains when the supplied sources do not support a conclusion.

guardrails: Require path, line number and exact quote for pass/fail decisions.
Reject citations that do not exist in the current checkout.
Human adjudication required for disputed, ambiguous or qualitative outcomes.
Do not replace executable regression tests with an LLM confidence score.
